method: count distinct values of the file column in PAIR_SCREEN, and compare the wording of C78 against C89 verbatim

file_column.form: plate-level filenames such as Plate 456_Batchie ExVivoEWS_...xlsx
file_column.conclusion: the column identifies plates, not arenas

wording_conflict.C78: BATCHIE two arenas are both unusable
wording_conflict.C89: three arenas, three units (key-raw / key-residual / pair-residual) all failed

findings.resolution: the three items in the C89 parenthesis are ANALYSIS UNITS, not datasets. There is no third dataset locally.

so_the_data_surface_is_two.gdsc_combinations: the primary arena where the claim lives
so_the_data_surface_is_two.batchie_pair: the cross-dataset attempt, judged unusable by C78 and C89

this_is_my_own_overstatement_of_evidence.impact_on_the_conclusion: C78 and C89 stand: PAIR is unusable under all three analyses. But cross-dataset now covers exactly one attempt, from GDSC to PAIR.
this_is_my_own_overstatement_of_evidence.so: the promotion criterion requiring cross-dataset replication has been attempted against ONE other dataset, not three

the_block_statement_changes_again.earlier_R170_version: the arenas are large enough, so failure points at construct validity rather than precision
the_block_statement_changes_again.now: that remains true for PAIR, but the evidential base is one dataset analysed three ways rather than three datasets
the_block_statement_changes_again.verdict: the block is real; the strength of the supporting replication is less than my phrasing implied

candidate_third_arenas_not_local.source: data_mapping.md lists them under Zenodo 12764821 as not downloaded
candidate_third_arenas_not_local.status: a further attempt is executable in principle but requires a download not performed here
